messages:
Samir: POC kickoff — Auriga.ai wants us to run Auriga-13B-v2 (QLoRA fine-tuned) for a search+chat workflow. Needs: model onboarding, perf numbers, pricing ballpark, and security answers. POC starts Mon. @Maria @Anika please.
Maria: Quick checklist — confirm quant format (q4_nf4?), kv-cache footprint, any special tokens from their fine-tune. Do we have sample weights?
Anika: They sent a sample bundle (link). Looks like QLoRA NF4 4-bit. No odd special tokens in the head. Quick perf notes: on A100-80GB single-stream ~120 tok/s, batching 8 -> ~900 tok/s. Token latency ~40-60ms with KV cache warm. Accuracy on our topical evals is within expected variance.
Devin: Infra note — Dedicated A100 pool fine. For hosted/dev we can run on smaller GPUs but need kernel support for NF4 fused ops. If fused kernels missing we'll be ~2-3x slower.
Maria: If fused kernels absent -> fallback plan: recommend q4_km profile, enable continuous batching, and expose auriga-13b-ptq-8 as a compatible lower-cost variant in the catalog.
Samir: Customer asked about POC pricing — they expect ~60k reqs/month. Can we provide a ballpark hosted vs dedicated delta?
Devin: Ballpark for hosted POC (gen-heavy): run a cost sim. Suggest temporary promo pricing: hosted gen $0.0009/token, embed $0.0002/unit for POC — but I'll run the simulator with their prompt/response distributions and post numbers.
Anika: Also important: their chat uses ~10k rolling context. If they insist on 10k we need 80GB+ GPU or further quantization + KV optimizations. Recommend test on 8k and 16k to see memory delta and throughput.
Sean: Security items: they require SOC2, customer-managed KMS (bring-your-own-key), VPC peering, SSO + audit logs, and EU data residency. Private deployment is an option. I'll start the security questionnaire v3.2 and flag KMS/HSM options.
Maria: I'll take the sec Q draft. Samir — confirm their tier (mid-market vs enterprise) so I can include SLA/dedicated options in pricing.
Samir: Enterprise — they need SLA + canary rollouts and rollback guarantees. Also asked for hallucination metrics on our eval promptset.
Anika: I'll run the hallucination/regression evals tonight and attach top-level metrics here tomorrow AM. Also will precompute retrieval embeddings for a small subset to test RAG.
infra-bot: deploy plan template created: https://console.redwood.internal/ops/poc-templates/auriga-13b
Devin: Sample model config we'll test locally and on Dedicated:
```
{"model":"auriga-13b-v2-qlora","quant":"q4_nf4","kv_cache":16384,"context":8192,"batching":{"max_batch_size":8,"latency_slo_ms":200}}
```
Maria: Next steps:
- Anika: perf + eval on A100, share numbers by EOD tomorrow
- Devin: kernel compatibility check + cost simulation
- Sean: start and return sec questionnaire answers, confirm KMS options
- Maria: draft POC SOW and pricing tiers + fallback mapping
Samir: Can we sync 15m tomorrow 10:00 to align before the customer call?
Anika: 10:00 works for me.
Sean: I'll join.
Samir: Adding calendar invite. :thumbsup:
Maria: I'll prep canary rollout notes and the mapping of model variants -> fallback (auriga-13b-ptq-8, auriga-7b-lite).
Samir: Thanks team — keeping this thread as the central sync. Ping here if blockers come up.
